FabG is the first member of the short-chain reductase superfamily to have its structure solved in both the binary and ternary states and is the first enzyme in the type II fatty acid synthase system to have its structure determined.
FabG has evolved to have a high degree of cooperativity between the active sites to maximize its catalytic efficiency.
